note: 全站术语唯一来源。章节里引用术语只能用这里的 key；要新增术语先加到这里，再由各层引用。中英对照与释义都由这里定，避免不同层翻出不同叫法。

def.zh: 量子信息的基本单元。超导量子比特是一个人工电路，不是粒子。
def.en: The basic unit of quantum information. A superconducting qubit is a manufactured circuit, not a particle.

def.zh: 目前主流的超导量子比特类型：用一个大电容把电荷噪声压下去，代价是对频率设计更敏感。
def.en: The dominant superconducting qubit design: a large shunt capacitor suppresses charge noise, at the cost of tighter frequency engineering.

def.zh: 两个超导体之间夹一层绝缘层，提供量子比特必需的非线性 —— 有了它，能级才不是等间距的。
def.en: An insulating barrier between two superconductors. It supplies the nonlinearity a qubit needs: without it, the energy levels would be equally spaced.

def.zh: 决定两个量子比特之间相互作用强度的可调元件，是两比特门和串扰控制的旋钮。
def.en: A tunable element that sets the interaction strength between two qubits — the knob for two-qubit gates and crosstalk control.

def.zh: 挂在量子比特旁边的微波谐振腔。它的频率随量子态移动，读出就是测这个移动量。
def.en: A microwave resonator coupled to a qubit. Its frequency shifts with the qubit state; measuring that shift is readout.

def.zh: 把两块芯片面对面用凸点连起来，比引线键合更短、更一致，是目前扩展量子比特数目常用的封装方式。
def.en: Joining two dies face-to-face with bumps. Shorter and more repeatable than wire bonding; a common way to scale qubit count.

def.zh: 用细金属丝把芯片焊盘连到载板，工艺成熟但每根线的电感与长度都要单独设计。
def.en: Thin metal wires connecting die pads to a carrier. Mature, but each wire's length and inductance must be designed.

def.zh: 用门和测量描述的一段量子计算流程，是提交给量子计算机的「源代码」形态。
def.en: A sequence of gates and measurements describing a computation — the "source code" you submit to a quantum computer.

def.zh: 把逻辑线路翻译成目标机器真正支持的门集合，并按芯片的拓扑结构重新路由。
def.en: Translates a logical circuit into the gate set the target machine actually supports, rerouting to match the chip topology.

def.zh: 把每个门展开成每一路通道上的一段波形与相位，是交给控制电子学的最终指令。
def.en: The final instruction to the control electronics: each gate expanded into a waveform and phase on every channel.

def.zh: 多用户共用一台机器时的调度机制；排队时间也是量子计算体验的一部分。
def.en: The scheduling layer when many users share one machine; queue time is part of the experience too.

def.zh: 量子测量只给一个结果，要重复很多次才得到概率分布 —— 一次重复叫一个 shot。
def.en: A single measurement returns one outcome. Repeating many times gives the distribution; each repeat is one shot.

def.zh: 机柜里那一层：产生波形、对齐时序、接收读出信号的设备，工作在 300 K。
def.en: The rack-level equipment that generates waveforms, aligns timing and captures readout, operating at 300 K.

def.zh: 按存储器里的采样点逐点输出电压的设备，是脉冲包络的来源。
def.en: A device that outputs voltage sample by sample from memory — the source of the pulse envelope.

def.zh: 把数字波形变成模拟电压的那一级；它的位数与采样率决定了波形的干净程度。
def.en: The stage that turns digital samples into analog voltage; its resolution and sample rate set how clean the waveform is.

def.zh: 负责实时时序与反馈逻辑的芯片：门与门之间的等待时间由它精确到纳秒地执行。
def.en: The chip handling real-time sequencing and feedback logic, executing nanosecond-level delays between gates.

def.zh: 用两路基带信号（同相 I 与正交 Q）合成任意相位与幅度的微波，是「任意门」的做法。
def.en: Combining two baseband signals (in-phase I and quadrature Q) to synthesise any phase and amplitude of microwave — how arbitrary gates are made.

def.zh: 混频用的参考微波源；它与基带信号相乘，把脉冲搬到量子比特的频率上。
def.en: The reference microwave source used in mixing; multiplied with the baseband signal, it shifts the pulse onto the qubit frequency.

def.zh: 信号下行的物理通道，同时是电的通路和热的通路 —— 这是低温布线最根本的矛盾。
def.en: The physical path into the fridge, and simultaneously an electrical and a thermal path — the fundamental tension of cryogenic wiring.

def.zh: 把线缆在某一级冷板上压紧固定，让热量卸在这一级，而不是继续往下传。
def.en: Clamping a cable to a cooling stage so heat is dumped there instead of travelling further down.

def.zh: 按固定比例削弱信号功率；在低温链路里它同时起「把室温噪声压下去」的作用。
def.en: Reduces signal power by a fixed ratio. In a cryogenic chain it also attenuates room-temperature noise travelling down.

def.zh: 衡量放大器自身噪声的单位：等效成「多加了多少开尔文的噪声」。
def.en: A measure of an amplifier's own noise, expressed as the temperature that would add the same amount.

def.zh: 单位温差下通过的热量。线材选型基本就是「电导要好、热导要小」的取舍。
def.en: Heat flow per unit temperature difference. Choosing cryogenic cable is largely a trade between electrical conduction and thermal conduction.

def.zh: 利用氦-3 / 氦-4 混合液「稀释」过程吸热的制冷机，是目前给超导量子芯片提供 10 mK 环境的标准设备。
def.en: A cryostat that cools by the enthalpy of mixing helium-3 into helium-4; the standard way to put superconducting chips at ~10 mK.

def.zh: 没有运动部件在冷端的预冷机，把 300 K 降到 50 K 与 4 K 两级。
def.en: A pre-cooler with no moving parts at the cold end, taking 300 K down to 50 K and 4 K.

def.zh: 稀释回路里约 0.9 K 的一级：加热让氦-3 蒸发离开混合液，再由泵抽走、循环使用。
def.en: The ~0.9 K stage of the dilution circuit: heating evaporates helium-3 out of the mixture so it can be pumped away and recycled.

def.zh: 整机最冷的一级（约 10 mK），量子芯片就挂在它下方。
def.en: The coldest stage of the machine (~10 mK); the quantum chip hangs below it.

def.zh: 每一级冷板外面套一层罩子，逐级挡住从更热一层辐射下来的光子。
def.en: A shell around each cooling stage, blocking thermal radiation from the warmer stage outside.

def.zh: 4 K 以下使用的超导同轴：直流电阻为零，但一旦超过临界温度就失去超导。
def.en: Superconducting coax used below 4 K: zero DC resistance, but it stops superconducting above its critical temperature.

def.zh: 接近量子极限的低温放大器，把微弱读出信号在 10 mK 一级先抬起来。
def.en: A near-quantum-limited cryogenic amplifier that lifts the weak readout signal at the 10 mK stage.

def.zh: 噪声低到接近量子力学允许下限的放大器，是读出效率的关键。
def.en: An amplifier whose added noise approaches the quantum limit; the key to efficient readout.

hemt.zh: 高电子迁移率晶体管放大器

def.zh: 4 K 一级的常规低噪声放大器，负责把信号再从低温链末端抬到室温电子学能处理的水平。
def.en: The conventional low-noise amplifier at 4 K, raising the signal to a level room-temperature electronics can handle.

def.zh: 单向器件：规定微波只能按一个方向走，用来把「发出去的信号」和「弹回来的信号」分开。
def.en: A one-way device: microwave may only travel in one direction, separating the outgoing tone from reflections.

def.zh: 环行器的一种用法，专门挡回波，防止下游噪声倒灌进量子比特。
def.en: A circulator used to block backward travelling noise from reaching the qubit.

def.zh: 给一个微波脉冲、看量子态随时间翻转的曲线 —— 校准 π 脉冲幅度靠它。
def.en: Drive a pulse and watch the state oscillate — the calibration curve for π-pulse amplitude.

t1-t2.zh: 能量弛豫与相位退相干

def.zh: T1 是量子比特回到基态的特征时间，T2 是它记住相位的时间。门必须在远短于这两个数的时间里做完。
def.en: T1 is how fast the qubit relaxes to the ground state; T2 is how long it remembers phase. Gates must be much faster than both.

def.zh: 用随机门序列把单个门的错误率测出来，避免被制备与测量误差污染。
def.en: Measuring per-gate error with random sequences, so preparation and measurement errors do not contaminate the number.

def.zh: 一个门做得有多准；99.9% 与 99.99% 之间，是「能演示」和「能纠错」的区别。
def.en: How accurately a gate is executed. The gap between 99.9% and 99.99% is the gap between a demo and error correction.

def.zh: 用多个物理量子比特编码一个逻辑量子比特，靠反复测量把错误压下去。
def.en: Encoding one logical qubit in many physical qubits and repeatedly measuring to suppress errors.

def.zh: 最常被提到的纠错码：只需近邻耦合与二维排布，正好贴合超导芯片的拓扑。
def.en: The most cited error-correcting code: nearest-neighbour coupling on a 2D lattice, which matches superconducting chip topology.

def.zh: 不增加物理比特，靠多次测量与后处理把这台机器的误差从结果里扣掉一部分。
def.en: Without extra qubits, using repeated measurements and post-processing to subtract part of the machine's error from the result.

def.zh: 用高磁导率合金把环境磁场挡在外面。超导量子比特对残余磁场很敏感，磁屏蔽是封装的一部分。
def.en: Blocking the ambient magnetic field with a high-permeability alloy. Superconducting qubits are sensitive to residual field, so the shield is part of the package.
